terms.gloss: the way of waging war, tactics
evidence: Liv. 22.39.9: ūna ratiō bellī gerendī adversus Hannibalem est, quā ego gessī
terms.comment: “The method of waging war”: Fabius in Livy, defending his way of fighting Hannibal. Caesar has novae ratiōnēs bellandī, new tactics (BC 3.50, Lewis & Short s.v. ratiō).

sources: Lewis & Short: ratio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 188, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
